title: また契約ゼロか  (Zero Contracts Again?)

segments.t: Back at Bianca International, an English encyclopedia sales office in Sapporo, the section chief calls Muranishi over to his desk. Muranishi has sold nothing all month, yet somehow stays cheerful. Listen to the boss's frustration and Muranishi's polite excuses.
村西、ちょっと。
はい。
また契約ゼロか？
不景気の影響ですかね。
違うよ。お前の問題だろ。
来月から来なくていい。
それは困りますよ。家族がいるんで。
ほんと不思議なやつだな。
ありがとうございます。
褒めてないよ！
前向きに生きろと父から教わったので。
小野から学んで結果を出せ。
Watch how Muranishi stays polite with 'masu' and 'desu' while his boss speaks down to him in plain, clipped endings.
村西、ちょっと。
"'Muranishi, a moment.' Calling someone's surname followed by " Notice how
ちょっと
, a little bit, this word is the classic office signal for 'step over here a second'.
また契約ゼロか？
'Zero contracts again?'  Check out
また
this word means again,
契約
this word is a business contract, and
ゼロ
is borrowed straight from English. Ending with the sharp
か
snaps the question shut.
不景気の影響ですかね。
'Maybe it is the effect of the recession.'  The word
不景気
combines the prefix for non- with the word for economic mood, giving 'recession'. Tacking
ですかね
onto the end softens his excuse into 'could it be... I wonder?'
違うよ。
"'Wrong.' Literally, " Here, the word
違う
this word means 'it differs', and speakers reach for it constantly to say 'no, that is wrong' or 'not at all'.
来月から来なくていい。
'You do not need to come in starting next month.'  The character says
来月
this word means next month, followed by
から
, from.
来なくていい
links the negative form for not come to the word for good—a cold boss's way of saying 'do not bother coming back'.
それは困りますよ。
'That puts me in a bind.'  It features
困ります
comes from the verb meaning to be troubled or stuck. Whenever a rule or schedule causes a problem,
それは困りますよ
politely pushes back without sounding rude.
家族がいるんで。
'I have a family.'  Here, the word
家族
is family, and living people take
いる
, to exist. Softening the word for because into
んで
leaves his plea hanging politely.
ほんと不思議なやつだな。
'You really are a strange guy.'  Listen for
不思議
this word means mysterious or baffling, and the rough
やつ
this word means guy or fellow.
褒めてないよ！
'I am not praising you!'  Starting off with
褒めてないよ
comes from the verb to praise—a key word that will soon transform Muranishi's entire sales career.
前向きに生きろと父から教わったので。
'My father taught me to live positively.'  Notice how
前向き
literally faces forward, so it this word means positive or upbeat.
父
this word is the humble word you use when speaking about your own father to outsiders.
小野から学んで結果を出せ。
'Learn from Ono and get results.'  The speaker uses
学んで
connects the verb for learn into the blunt command
結果を出せ
, literally 'put out results!' Now let's listen to the whole office scolding again.
村西、ちょっと。
はい。
また契約ゼロか？
不景気の影響ですかね。
違うよ。お前の問題だろ。
来月から来なくていい。
それは困りますよ。家族がいるんで。
ほんと不思議なやつだな。
ありがとうございます。
褒めてないよ！
前向きに生きろと父から教わったので。
小野から学んで結果を出せ。
Keep the phrase for 'that is wrong' handy, express being troubled when something causes problems, and remember how to talk about having family. See you next time.
さようなら。

source.show: 全裸監督 (The Naked Director) S01E01
